data.long_meaning: The name Bawa is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Brahman', which means 'The Supreme God'. The name Bawa is used for boys and it signifies a person who is learned, wise, and a descendant of the Brahmin community. The name Bawa carries the meaning “Brahmin, Scholar” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bawa usually hope their child will grow to embody brahmin, scholar and live with faith, good character and purpose.
